Abolish Disease.desc: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

Accelerant.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

Adrenaline Rush.desc: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

Aftermath.desc: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

Aggression.desc: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 15%.

Agonizing Flames.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

Aimed Shot.desc: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

Ambush.desc: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

Amplify Curse.desc: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

Amplify Magic.desc: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 23 and healing spells by up to 45. Lasts 600 sec.

Ancestral Healing.desc: Increases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

Anger Management.desc: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

shaman.desc: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%.

Aquatic Form.desc: Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Arcane Blast.desc: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

Arcane Brilliance.desc: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 3600 sec.

Arcane Concentration.desc: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Arcane Explosion.desc: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 32 to 36 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

Arcane Focus.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

Arcane Geometry.desc: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

Arcane Impact.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

Arcane Instability.desc: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

Arcane Intellect.desc: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 for 3600 sec.

Arcane Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Arcane Mind.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

Arcane Missiles.desc: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 25 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec.

Arcane Power.desc: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

Arcane Resilience.desc: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 75% of your Intellect.

Arcane Shielding.desc: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

Arcane Shot.desc: An instant shot that causes 25 Arcane damage.

Arcane Subtlety.desc: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

Arcane Wrath.desc: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

Arctic Reach.desc: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

Armorsmith.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

Artisan's Precision.desc: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.

Aspect of the Beast.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Cheetah.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Hawk.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Monkey.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Pack.desc: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Wild.desc: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Auto Shot.desc: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

Backstab.desc: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

Bait and Tackle.desc: Allows the fisher to add features to a wilderness camp.

Bane.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

Bane of Agony.desc: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 72 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Bane of Doom.desc: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 60 sec. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Bane of Havoc.desc: Afflicts the target for 300 sec, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Banish.desc: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

Barkskin.desc: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

Barrage.desc: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

Bastion.desc: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

Battle Shout.desc: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 12. Lasts 180 sec.

Benediction.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

Berserker Rage.desc: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Berserker Stance.desc: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

Bestial Discipline.desc: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Bestial Swiftness.desc: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

Bestial Wrath.desc: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

Bite.desc: Bite the enemy, causing 7 to 9 damage.

Blackout.desc: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

Blade Flurry.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

Blast Wave.desc: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

Blessed Recovery.desc: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

Blessing of Freedom.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Kings.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Might.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 14 for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Protection.desc: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Blessing of Sacrifice.desc: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 45 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Wisdom.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 12 mana every 5 seconds for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blind.desc: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

Blink.desc: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

Blizzard.desc: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 196 Frost damage over 8 sec.

Blood Craze.desc: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

Blood Frenzy.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Blood Fury.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

Blood Splatter.desc: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec.

Bloodrage.desc: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

Bloodthirst.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

Bloodthrill.desc: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

Bloom.desc: When your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to 100% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for 50% of your Spirit instead.

Booming Voice.desc: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces the Rage cost by of your Shouts and Howls by 25%.

Boot Knife.desc: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

Boundless Light.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 30% when cast on allies not affected by your Oath of Light.

Bountiful Harvest.desc: You are 100% more likely to discover Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.

Brutal Impact.desc: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

Burning Soul.desc: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

Call of Flame.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 15%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 9 sec.

Call of Thunder.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 5%.

Call of the Elements.desc: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

Camouflage.desc: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

Cannibalize.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

Careful Aim.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

Cataclysm.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

Chain Heal.desc: Heals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

Chain Lightning.desc: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 208 to 236 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

Challenging Roar.desc: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Challenging Shout.desc: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Champion of the Light.desc: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec.

hunter.desc: Charges an enemy, immobilizes it for 1 sec, and adds 66 melee attack power to the boar's next attack.

warrior.desc: Charge an enemy, generate 9 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

Charge.desc: Charge an enemy, generate 9 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

Chastise.desc: Chastise the target, causing 43 to 49 Holy damage and immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

Cheap Shot.desc: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

druid.desc: Claw the enemy for 140% normal damage plus 27. Awards 1 combo point.

hunter.desc: Claw the enemy, causing 4 to 6 damage.

Claw.desc: Claw the enemy for 140% normal damage plus 27. Awards 1 combo point.

Cleanse.desc: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

Cleave.desc: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

Clever Traps.desc: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

Cold Blood.desc: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

Cold Snap.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

Combustion.desc: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

druid.desc: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

mage.desc: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

warrior.desc: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

Command.desc: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

Compact Critter Carrier.desc: Place a Compact Critter Carrier for 180 sec that allows Hunters in your group to access their stabled pets.

Composure.desc: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10.

Concentration Aura.desc: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Concussion.desc: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.

Concussive Shot.desc: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

Cone of Cold.desc: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.

Conflagrate.desc: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

Confounding Flash.desc: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

Conjure Food.desc: Conjures 20 muffins, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Conjure Mana Agate.desc: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 375 to 425 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Conjure Mana Citrine.desc: Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 775 to 925 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Conjure Mana Jade.desc: Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 550 to 650 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Conjure Mana Ruby.desc: Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1000 to 1200 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Conjure Water.desc: Conjures 20 bottles of water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Consecrated Ground.desc: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

Consecration.desc: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec.

Convection.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.

Conviction.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 6%.

Corruption.desc: Corrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec.

Counterattack.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Counterspell.desc: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

Coup de Grace.desc: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.

druid.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

hunter.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

Cower.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

Create Firestone.desc: Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 1% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 10. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Create Healthstone.desc: Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 120 health. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Create Soulstone.desc: Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Create Spellstone.desc: Creates a Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 1% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 14. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Critical Mass.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

Cruelty.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

Crusade.desc: Increases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets.

Cultivation.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

priest.desc: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

Cure Disease.desc: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

druid.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

shaman.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

Cure Poison.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

Curse of Exhaustion.desc: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Recklessness.desc: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 175 for 120 sec. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Shadow.desc: Curses the target for 180 sec, reducing Shadow and Arcane resistances by 75 and increasing Shadow and Arcane damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Tongues.desc: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 50%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

Curse of Weakness.desc: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 4 for 120 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of the Elements.desc: Curses the target for 300 sec, reducing Magic resistances by 30 and increases Magic damage taken by 4%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Dark Inspiration.desc: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.

Dark Sacrifice.desc: Cannibalize 440 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 440 Mana.

Darkness.desc: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

druid.desc: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

hunter.desc: Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Dash.desc: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

Deadly Aspects.desc: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

Death Coil.desc: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 285 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

Death Wish.desc: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

Decimation.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

Deep Wounds.desc: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 60% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

Defensive Stance.desc: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 80%.

Defiance.desc: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 20% while a shield is equipped.

Demon Skin.desc: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 40 and increases health regeneration by 3 health per 5 sec. for 1800 sec.

Demonic Aegis.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

Demonic Energies.desc: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

Demonic Knowledge.desc: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

Demonic Pact.desc: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

Demonic Sacrifice.desc: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 7200 sec. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

Demoralizing Roar.desc: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 56. Lasts 30 sec.

Demoralizing Screech.desc: Blasts a single enemy for 7 to 9 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 63 for 30 sec.

Demoralizing Shout.desc: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 63 for 45 sec.

Desperate Prayer.desc: Instantly heals the caster for 146 to 181.

Destructive Reach.desc: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

Deterrence.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Devastation.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

Devotion Aura.desc: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Devour Magic.desc: Purges 1 harmful magic effect from a friend or 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy. If an effect is devoured, the Felhunter will be healed for 258.

Devouring Contagion.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

Devouring Plague.desc: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 128 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

Dire Bear Form.desc: Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 180, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 1240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Dirty Deeds.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

Dirty Tricks.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

Disarm.desc: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

Disease Cleansing Totem.desc: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 300 sec.

Disengage.desc: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.

Dismember.desc: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 11 to 13 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 25% for 6 sec.

Dispel Magic.desc: Dispels magic on the target, removing 1 harmful spell from a friend or 1 beneficial spell from an enemy.

Distract.desc: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

Dive.desc: Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Divine Favor.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

Divine Fury.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

Divine Grace.desc: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 146 to 181 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

Divine Intervention.desc: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 180 sec.

Divine Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 8%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by 20%.

Divine Protection.desc: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 6 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Divine Shield.desc: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Divine Spirit.desc: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 3600 sec.

Drain Life.desc: Transfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

Drain Mana.desc: Transfers 44 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

Drain Soul.desc: Drains the soul of the target, causing 85 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

rogue.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

warrior.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.

Dual Wield Specialization.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

Dust Cloud.desc: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 65 for 30 sec.

Dust to Motes.desc: Divides 1 pile of Strange Dust into 3 Motes of Magic.

EZ-Thro Dark Bomb.desc: Inflicts 225 to 675 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yd radius for 4 sec. Any damage will break the effect.

EZ-Thro Mana Bomb.desc: Burns 675 to 1125 mana from those in the blast radius and deals 50% of the mana drained in damage to the target. Also Silences targets in the blast for 5 sec.

EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade.desc: Inflicts 300 to 500 Fire damage and stuns targets for 3 sec in a 3 yd radius. Any damage will break the effect.

Early Demise.desc: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

Earth Shock.desc: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 21 to 24 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Earthbound.desc: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

Eclipse.desc: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.50 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Efficiency.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

Efficient Strikes.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5.

Elemental Alacrity.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.50 sec.

Elemental Devastation.desc: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

Elemental Focus.desc: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Elemental Fury.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

Elemental Insight.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

Elemental Weapons.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 40% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 15%.

Elune's Grace.desc: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

Elune's Light.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

Elusiveness.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

Emberstorm.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 10% and reduces the cast time of your Searing Pain spell by 0.5 sec.

rogue.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

Endurance Training.desc: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

Enhancing Totems.desc: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by 8%.

druid.desc: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

warrior.desc: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

Enrage.desc: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

Entangling Roots.desc: Roots the target in place and causes 20 Nature damage over 12 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

Entrapment.desc: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

Escape Artist.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

mage.desc: Your damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

priest.desc: Your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage or healing for 8 sec.

rogue.desc: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

warlock.desc: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

warrior.desc: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

Eureka!.desc: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

Evasion.desc: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

Eviscerate.desc: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : 6-10 damage 2 points: 11-15 damage 3 points: 16-20 damage 4 points: 21-25 damage 5 points: 26-30 damage

Evocation.desc: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec.

Execute.desc: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 125 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 3 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Exorcism.desc: Causes 80 to 90 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

Explosive Trap.desc: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 105 to 135 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 60 sec. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

Expose Armor.desc: Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing Armor per combo point: 1 point : 90 Armor 2 points: 180 Armor 3 points: 270 Armor 4 points: 360 Armor 5 points: 450 Armor

Expose Prey.desc: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.

Eye for an Eye.desc: All critical strikes against you cause 10% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

Eye of the Storm.desc: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Fade.desc: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec.

Faerie Fire.desc: Decrease the armor of the target by 175 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

Fear.desc: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

Fear Ward.desc: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec.

Feedback.desc: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 18 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

Feign Death.desc: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 360 sec. If not cancelled, after 360 sec you will actually die.

Feint.desc: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

Fel Concentration.desc: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Fel Domination.desc: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

Fel Vitality.desc: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

Feral Instinct.desc: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 30% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 3 levels higher.

Feral Swiftness.desc: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

Ferocious Bite.desc: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 0.7 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power. 1 point : 40-54 damage 2 points: 70-84 damage 3 points: 100-114 damage 4 points: 130-144 damage 5 points: 160-174 damage

druid.desc: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

hunter.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

Ferocity.desc: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

Field Medicine.desc: Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 10 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

Find Fish.desc: Nearby fishing nodes appear on the minimap.

Fingers of Frost.desc: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

Fire Blast.desc: Blasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage.

Fire Nova.desc: Instantly inflicts 32 to 38 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.

Fire Power.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

Fire Resistance Aura.desc: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Fire Shield.desc: Surrounds the target in a shield of fire. Every strike against the target causes 5 Fire damage to the attacker. Lasts 180 sec. Your pet cannot cast Fire Shield on itself.

Fire and Brimstone.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

Fireball.desc: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 15 to 23 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec.

Firebolt.desc: Deals 6 to 8 Fire damage to a target.

Flame Shock.desc: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 29 Fire damage immediately and 28 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Flamestrike.desc: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 55 to 71 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.

Flametongue Weapon.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 4.71 to 18 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Flare.desc: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

Flash Heal.desc: Heals a friendly target for 184 to 223.

Flash of Light.desc: Heals a friendly target for 48 to 54.

Flash of Steel.desc: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 15 and reduces its cooldown by 2.0 sec.

Flawless Execution.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.

shaman.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

warrior.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Flurry.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Focused Fire.desc: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

Focused Rage.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

Force of Will.desc: Increases your spell damage by 1% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 1%.

Freezing Trap.desc: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 60 sec. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

Frenzied Regeneration.desc: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

Frenzy.desc: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

Frost Armor.desc: Increases Armor by 30. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec.

Frost Channeling.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

Frost Nova.desc: Blasts enemies near the caster for 21 to 24 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Frost Resistance Aura.desc: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Frost Shock.desc: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 99 to 106 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

Frost Trap.desc: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 60 sec. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

Frost Warding.desc: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

Frostbite.desc: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

Frostbolt.desc: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 19 to 21 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.

Frostfire Bolt.desc: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 103 to 118 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 27 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.

Furious Howl.desc: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 15 yards by 13. Lasts 60 sec.

Furious Precision.desc: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

Furor.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 100% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 100 Energy.

Garrote.desc: Garrote the enemy, causing 144 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Genesis.desc: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 10%.

Ghost Wolf.desc: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

Ghostly Strike.desc: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

Gift of Nature.desc: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 10%.

Gift of the Wild.desc: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 324, all attributes by 14 and all resistances by 20 for 3600 sec.

Gore Drinker.desc: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, Reckless Swings, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

Gouge.desc: Causes 10 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

Gourmand.desc: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 100%.

Grace of Air Totem.desc: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 49. Lasts 300 sec.

Greater Blessing of Kings.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Greater Blessing of Might.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 112 for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Greater Blessing of Wisdom.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 36 mana every 5 seconds for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Greater Heal.desc: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 819 to 920.

Grim Reach.desc: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

druid.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

hunter.desc: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

Growl.desc: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

Guardian's Favor.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 2 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 6 sec.

Hack and Slash.desc: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

Hammer of Wrath.desc: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 286 to 314 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Hamstring.desc: Maims the enemy, causing 5 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 40% for 15 sec.

Hardiness.desc: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

Hawk Eye.desc: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

Healing Focus.desc: Gives your healing spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Healing Grace.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 10%.

Healing Light.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 12%.

Healing Stream Totem.desc: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 300 sec that heals group members within 30 yards for 5 every 2 seconds.

Healing Touch.desc: Heals a friendly target for 40 to 54.

Healing Wave.desc: Heals a friendly target for 37 to 47.

Healing Way.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.

Health Funnel.desc: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

Heart of the Wild.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

Heating Up.desc: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

Hellfire.desc: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 86 Fire damage to himself and 86 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

Hemorrhage.desc: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

Heroic Strike.desc: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

Hex of Weakness.desc: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 43 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 120 sec.

Holy Binding.desc: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.

Holy Conduit.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

Holy Fire.desc: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 53 to 65 Holy damage and an additional 20 Holy damage over 10 sec.

Holy Light.desc: Heals a friendly target for 42 to 50.

Holy Nova.desc: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

Holy Power.desc: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by 50%.

Holy Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

Holy Reach.desc: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.

Holy Shield.desc: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

Holy Shock.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

Holy Specialization.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.

Holy Strike.desc: An instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage.

Holy Wrath.desc: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 368 to 434 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds and stunning them for 2 sec.

Howl of Terror.desc: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Humanoid Slaying.desc: Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by 1% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional 1%.

Hunter's Mark.desc: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 120 sec.

Hurricane.desc: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 69 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

Ice Armor.desc: Increases Armor by 290 and frost resistance by 6. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec.

Ice Barrier.desc: Shield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 60 sec. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

Ice Block.desc: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Ice Lance.desc: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

Ice Shards.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

Ignite.desc: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

Illumination.desc: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

Immolate.desc: Burns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec.

Immolation Trap.desc: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 60 sec. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

Impact.desc: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

Impale.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

Improved Ambush.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

Improved Arcane Shot.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Improved Aspect of the Hawk.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Aspect of the Hawk by 20%.

Improved Bane of Agony.desc: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

Improved Battle Shout.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout by 5%.

Improved Berserker Rage.desc: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

Improved Blessing of Might.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 4%.

Improved Blessing of Wisdom.desc: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 10%.

Improved Blizzard.desc: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

Improved Bloodrage.desc: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

Improved Channeling.desc: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Improved Charge.desc: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

Improved Cleave.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 3.

Improved Concentration Aura.desc: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 15%, and your Concentration Aura also reduces the duration of Silence and Interrupt effects on your party members by 30%.

Improved Cone of Cold.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

Improved Corruption.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

Improved Counterspell.desc: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

Improved Curse of Exhaustion.desc: Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 5%.

Improved Curse of Weakness.desc: Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 6%.

Improved Demoralizing Shout.desc: Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 8%.

Improved Devotion Aura.desc: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 5%, and increases all healing received by party members affected by your Auras by 2%.

Improved Disarm.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

Improved Drain Life.desc: Health or Mana gained from Drain Life and Drain Mana increased by 15%.

Improved Drains.desc: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 20%.

Improved Entangling Roots.desc: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

Improved Execute.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

Improved Expose Armor.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

Improved Eyes of the Beast.desc: Increases the duration of your Eyes of the Beast by 30 sec.

Improved Fade.desc: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

Improved Feign Death.desc: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by 2%.

Improved Felhunter.desc: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

Improved Fire Blast.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

Improved Firebolt.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 0.5 sec.

Improved Firestone.desc: Increases the bonus Fire damage from Firestones and the Firestone effect by 15%.

Improved Frost Nova.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

Improved Frostbolt.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

Improved Ghost Wolf.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Improved Hamstring.desc: Gives your Hamstring ability a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

Improved Healing.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

Improved Healing Wave.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.

Improved Health Funnel.desc: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

Improved Healthstone.desc: Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 10%.

Improved Heroic Strike.desc: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 Rage.

Improved Holy Strike.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.

Improved Hunter's Mark.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Hunter's Mark spell by 3%.

Improved Immolate.desc: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 5%.

Improved Imp.desc: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

Improved Inner Fire.desc: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

Improved Judgement.desc: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 2 sec.

Improved Lash of Pain.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain spell by 3 sec.

Improved Life Tap.desc: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

Improved Mana Burn.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

Improved Mend Pet.desc: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

Improved Mind Blast.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.

Improved Mind Flay.desc: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 20% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

Improved Moonfire.desc: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 10%.

Improved Overpower.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

Improved Poisons.desc: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

Improved Power Word: Fortitude.desc: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 15%.

Improved Power Word: Shield.desc: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

Improved Psychic Scream.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

Improved Regrowth.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 50%.

Improved Reincarnation.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 20 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 20%.

Improved Rejuvenation.desc: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

Improved Rend.desc: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

Improved Renew.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

Improved Retribution Aura.desc: Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by 25%.

Improved Revenge.desc: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

Improved Revive Pet.desc: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

Improved Righteous Fury.desc: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 9%.

Improved Sayaad.desc: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

Improved Scorch.desc: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Improved Seal of the Crusader.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 5%.

Improved Seals.desc: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.

Improved Serpent Sting.desc: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

Improved Shadow Bolt.desc: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

Improved Shadow Word: Pain.desc: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

Improved Shield Bash.desc: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

Improved Shield Block.desc: Allows your Shield Block ability to block an additional attack and increases the duration by 0.5 second.

Improved Shield Wall.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11.0 min.

Improved Slam.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Slam ability by 5.0 sec, the cast time and global cooldown by 0.50 sec, and Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing.

Improved Slice and Dice.desc: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

Improved Spellstone.desc: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your Spellstone by 15%.

Improved Sprint.desc: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

Improved Starfire.desc: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.5 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

Improved Stings.desc: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

Improved Stormstrike.desc: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

Improved Subjugate Demon.desc: Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 2% and reduces the resist chance by 2%.

Improved Sunder Armor.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

Improved Tactical Mastery.desc: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

Improved Taunt.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Taunt ability by 1 sec.

Improved Thunder Clap.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

Improved Tracking.desc: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

Improved Tranquility.desc: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

Improved Vampiric Embrace.desc: Increases the percentage healed by your Vampiric Embrace by an additional 5%.

Improved Voidwalker.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

Improved Weapon Totems.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Windfury Totem by 15% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Totem by 6%.

Improved Whirlwind.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind ability by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals to the closest enemy by 30%.

Improved Wing Clip.desc: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

Improved Wrath.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.5 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

Incinerate.desc: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

Incineration.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 10%.

Inferno.desc: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 300 sec. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

Infusion of Light.desc: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.

Initiative.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

Inner Fire.desc: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 315. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 600 sec or until 20 charges are used.

Inner Focus.desc: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

Insect Swarm.desc: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

Inspiration.desc: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

Intensity.desc: Gives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Intercept.desc: Charge an enemy, causing 25 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

Intimidating Shout.desc: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

Intimidation.desc: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

Iron Creed.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 6% for 6 sec.

Iron Will.desc: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

Judgement.desc: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

Judgement of Light.desc: Melee attacks made against you have a chance of causing the attacker to be healed for 25.

Judgement of Wisdom.desc: Attacks and spells used against the target have a chance of restoring 33 of the attacker's mana.

Kick.desc: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 15 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

Kidney Shot.desc: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 1 second 2 points: 2 seconds 3 points: 3 seconds 4 points: 4 seconds 5 points: 5 seconds

Killer Instinct.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 3%.

druid.desc: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 20 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

hunter.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

Lacerate.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

Lacerating Strikes.desc: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

Lash of Pain.desc: An instant attack that lashes the target, causing 16 Shadow damage.

Last Stand.desc: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Lasting Judgement.desc: Increases the duration of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom by 10 sec.

Lay on Hands.desc: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

Leader of the Pack.desc: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

Lesser Healing Wave.desc: Heals a friendly target for 151 to 172.

Lethal Attacks.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

Lethal Shots.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by 2%.

Lethality.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

Levitate.desc: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 120 sec.

Life Tap.desc: Converts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.

Light's Vigil.desc: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 326 to 344. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

Lightning Bolt.desc: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage.

Lightning Breath.desc: Breathes lightning, instantly dealing 8 to 10 Nature damage to a single target.

Lightning Mastery.desc: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

Lightning Overload.desc: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Lightning Shield.desc: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec.

Lightwell.desc: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 800 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 180 sec or 5 charges.

Lingering Rage.desc: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

Litany of Light.desc: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

Lone Wolf.desc: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

Luremaster.desc: While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 50% chance to catch an extra fish.

Maelstrom Weapon.desc: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Mage Armor.desc: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec.

Magic Absorption.desc: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

Magic Attunement.desc: Increases the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 50%.

Magma Totem.desc: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 20 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

Malevolence.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

Malice.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

Mana Shield.desc: Absorbs 120 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 60 sec.

Mana Spring Totem.desc: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 300 sec that restores 4 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Mana Tide Totem.desc: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Mark of the Wild.desc: Increases the friendly target's armor by 34 for 3600 sec.

Master Chef.desc: Your cooking recipes have a 30% chance to create an extra result.

Master Demonologist.desc: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

Master Summoner.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

Master of Deception.desc: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

Master of Defense.desc: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

Master of Elements.desc: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

Maul.desc: Increases the druid's next attack by 18 damage.

Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Mend Pet.desc: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

Mental Agility.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

Mental Dexterity.desc: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

Mental Quickness.desc: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

Mind Blast.desc: Blasts the target for 40 to 44 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

Mind Control.desc: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 44, but increases the time between its attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 60 sec.

Mind Flay.desc: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

Mindfulness.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Mine!.desc: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 10 to 12 damage and disarming them for 3 sec.

Missile Barrage.desc: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

Mocking Blow.desc: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Mongoose Bite.desc: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge.

Monster Slaying.desc: Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by 2% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by an additional 2%.

Moonfire.desc: Burns the enemy for 10 to 12 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec.

Moonfury.desc: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 10%.

Moonglow.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

Moonkin Form.desc: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Mortal Shots.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

Mortal Strike.desc: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Multi-Shot.desc: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

Mutilate.desc: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

Natural Grace.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.
