Natural Instinct.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

Natural Reaction.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 5%, and gives you a 100% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

Natural Shapeshifter.desc: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.

Naturalist.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by 0.5 sec and increases all damage you deal by 10%.

Nature's Focus.desc: Gives your Arcane and Nature spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Nature's Grace.desc: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

Nature's Grasp.desc: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

Nature's Guidance.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

Nature's Majesty.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 4%.

Nature's Reach.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

Nature's Splendor.desc: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

druid.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

shaman.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Nature's Swiftness.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Nightfall.desc: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

Omen of Clarity.desc: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

One-Handed Weapon Specialization.desc: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

Opportunity.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 20%.

Overgrowth.desc: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

Overpower.desc: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

Pandemic.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

hunter.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

paladin.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

rogue.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

shaman.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

warrior.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

Parry.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

Pathfinding.desc: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

Penance.desc: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

Performance Bonus.desc: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

Permafrost.desc: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

Permanence.desc: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.

Pick Lock.desc: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

Piercing Howl.desc: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

Piercing Ice.desc: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

Pinch.desc: Pinches an enemy's legs for 19 to 21 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

Plainsrunning.desc: Gain 2% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 60% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect.

druid.desc: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

rogue.desc: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

Poised.desc: While at maximum Energy, and out of combat, reduce the Energy cost of your next ability by 10.

Polymorph.desc: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

Polymorph: Cow.desc: Transforms the enemy into a cow, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the cow cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

Portal of Summoning.desc: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Pounce.desc: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 114 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Power Infusion.desc: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

Power Word: Fortitude.desc: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 4 for 3600 sec.

Power Word: Shield.desc: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

Power in Light.desc: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

Prayer of Fortitude.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 56 for 3600 sec.

Prayer of Healing.desc: A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 179 to 191. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.

Prayer of Mending.desc: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 172 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

Prayer of Shadow Protection.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 1200 sec.

Prayer of Spirit.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 3600 sec.

mage.desc: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

paladin.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

rogue.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

Predator's Edge.desc: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

Predatory Discipline.desc: Your Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy.

Predatory Strikes.desc: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level.

Premeditation.desc: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

Preparation.desc: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

Presence of Mind.desc: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Primal Bite.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 42 and generating a high amount of threat.

druid.desc: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled.

hunter.desc: Puts your pet in stealth mode, but slows its movement speed by 50%. The first attack from stealth receives a 20% bonus to damage. Lasts until cancelled.

Prowl.desc: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled.

Psychic Scream.desc: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 2 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Pummel.desc: Pummel the target for 20 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

Puncturing Wounds.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Purification.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

Purify.desc: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

Purifying Power.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 33%.

Pursuit of Justice.desc: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Pyroblast.desc: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Pyroclasm.desc: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

Quick Getaway.desc: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

Rage of the Farseer.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

Rain of Fire.desc: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 166 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Rake.desc: Rake the target for 27 damage and an additional 60 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Ranged Weapon Specialization.desc: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

Rapid Fire.desc: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Rapid Killing.desc: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

Rapid Recuperation.desc: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

Raptor Strike.desc: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5.

Ravage.desc: Ravage the target, causing 435% damage plus 42 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Read Leyline.desc: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. If a leyline is nearby, you will become Attuned for the next 3600 sec and the effect of this ability will be increased by 100%.

Reagent Economy.desc: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors.

Rebirth.desc: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 400 health and 700 mana.

Reckless Swings.desc: Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 additional Rage. Lasts 8 sec.

Recklessness.desc: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

Reckoning.desc: Gives you a 40% chance after Blocking and a 100% chance after receiving a non-periodic critical strike to gain an extra attack. Stores up to 4 extra attacks. Cannot occur from Blocks more than once every 1.5 sec.

Redemption.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

Redoubt.desc: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 30%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

Reflection.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Regrowth.desc: Heals a friendly target for 89 to 103 and another 91 over 21 sec.

Reincarnation.desc: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

Rejuvenation.desc: Heals the target for 32 over 12 sec.

Relentless Strikes.desc: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

Remorseless Attacks.desc: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

Remove Lesser Curse.desc: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

Rend.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 15 damage over 9 sec.

Rend and Tear.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 15%.

Renew.desc: Heals the target of 45 damage over 15 sec.

Renewed Hope.desc: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

Repentance.desc: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

Research.desc: Research the magical arts with the help of a library.

Resourcefulness.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 60%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

Restorative Totems.desc: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

Resurrection.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

Retaliation.desc: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

Retribution Aura.desc: Causes 5 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Revenge.desc: Instantly counterattack an enemy for (20 + 22.5% of attack power) to (24 + 22.5% of attack power) damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

Reverberation.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 1.0 sec.

Reverence.desc: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Revive.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

Righteous Fury.desc: Increases all threat generated by 33%, and all threat generated by your Holy attacks by an additional 90%. Lasts 1800 sec.

Rip.desc: Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 57 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 90 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 123 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 156 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 189 damage over 12 sec.

Riptide.desc: Heals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

Ritual of Doom.desc: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Ritual of Summoning.desc: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Rockbiter Weapon.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 49 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Ruin.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

Rupture.desc: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 25 damage over 8 secs 2 points: 37 damage over 10 secs 3 points: 51 damage over 12 secs 4 points: 68 damage over 14 secs 5 points: 87 damage over 16 secs

Ruthless.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%.

Ruthlessness.desc: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

Sacred Arbiter.desc: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

Sacred Duty.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec, and reduces the duration of Forbearance by 10 sec.

Sanctified Judgement.desc: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

Sanctity Aura.desc: Increases Holy damage done by party members within 30 yards by 10%. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Sap.desc: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.

Savage Fury.desc: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 10%.

Savage Rend.desc: Slash an enemy with razor talons, causing the target to Bleed for 30 damage over 18 sec.

Savage Strikes.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 4%.

Scatter Shot.desc: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Scorch.desc: Scorch the enemy for 38 to 46 Fire damage.

Scorpid Sting.desc: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Seal Fate.desc: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Seal of Command.desc: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 70.9 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

Seal of Fury.desc: Fills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 32 to 34 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.

Seal of Justice.desc: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Seal of Light.desc: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Seal of Righteousness.desc: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 2.48 to 8.64 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Seal of Wisdom.desc: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Seal of the Crusader.desc: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 35 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 23. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Searing Light.desc: Increases your Holy damage done by 5%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

Searing Pain.desc: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 24 to 29 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

Searing Totem.desc: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 30 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 9 to 11 Fire damage.

Serpent Sting.desc: Stings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Serrated Blades.desc: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

Setup.desc: Gives you a 45% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

Shackle Undead.desc: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 30 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

Shadow Affinity.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.

Shadow Bolt.desc: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 12 to 16 Shadow damage.

Shadow Focus.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

Shadow Mastery.desc: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 10%.

Shadow Protection.desc: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 30 for 600 sec.

Shadow Reach.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

Shadow Resistance Aura.desc: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Shadow Weaving.desc: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Shadow Word: Death.desc: A word of dark binding that inflicts 294 to 311 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 30% of your maximum health.

Shadow Word: Pain.desc: A word of darkness that causes 30 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

Shadow and Flame.desc: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

Shadowburn.desc: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Shadowform.desc: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

Shadowguard.desc: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 600 sec.

Shadowmeld.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

Shamanistic Focus.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

Shank.desc: Instantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy. Shank cannot Miss.

Sharpened Claws.desc: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 6%.

Shatter.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

Shatter Curse.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

Shell Shield.desc: Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50% and increases the time between your pet's attacks by 60%, but deals more damage with each attack. Lasts 12 sec.

Shield Bash.desc: Bashes the target with your shield for 6 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

Shield Block.desc: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

Shield Slam.desc: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

paladin.desc: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.

shaman.desc: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 5% and increases the amount blocked by 25%.

warrior.desc: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

Shield Specialization.desc: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and increases the amount blocked by 5%.

Shield Wall.desc: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

Shieldsworn.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 4 sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for 6 sec.

Shred.desc: Shred the target, causing 200% damage plus 22 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Shredding Attacks.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 18 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 3.

Silence.desc: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

Silent Resolve.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

Sinister Strike.desc: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

Siphon Life.desc: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

Skysight.desc: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 15% for 30 sec. If an elemental convergence is nearby, you will become Charged for the next 3600 sec and the effect of this ability will be increased by 100%.

Slam.desc: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.

Slice and Dice.desc: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 15 seconds 4 points: 18 seconds 5 points: 21 seconds

Smite.desc: Smite an enemy for 13 to 18 Holy damage.

Sniper Shot.desc: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

Sonic Blast.desc: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 15 to 17 Nature damage and increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 20 sec.

Soul Fire.desc: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 344 to 430 Fire damage.

Soul Harvest.desc: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Soul Link.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

Soul Siphon.desc: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

Soul Warding.desc: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

Spearing Strike.desc: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

Spell Lock.desc: Silences the enemy for 3 sec. If used on a casting target, it will counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.

Spirit Tap.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

Spirit Weapons.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Spirit of Redemption.desc: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

Spiritual Focus.desc: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Spiritual Guidance.desc: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

Spiritual Healing.desc: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

Sprint.desc: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

Starfire.desc: Causes 111 to 133 Arcane damage to the target.

Starshards.desc: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 162 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

Stealth.desc: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled.

Stoicism.desc: Reduces the duration of Stun and Charm effects on you by 20%.

Stoneclaw Totem.desc: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 50 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

Stoneform.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

Stoneskin Totem.desc: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 4. Lasts 300 sec.

Stormstrike.desc: Instantly strike for 100% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Strength of Earth Totem.desc: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 7. Lasts 300 sec.

Strider Kick.desc: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

Study.desc: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.

Subjugate Demon.desc: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 45, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 300 sec. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

Subtlety.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

Summon Dreadsteed.desc: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

Summon Felhunter.desc: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Felsteed.desc: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

Summon Hawk.desc: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing (32 + 5% of ranged attack power) Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Summon Imp.desc: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Incubus.desc: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Succubus.desc: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Warhorse.desc: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount.

Sunder Armor.desc: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 90 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Suppression.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

Surefooted.desc: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

Survival Tactics.desc: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 10%.

Survivalist's Discipline.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

Sweeping Strikes.desc: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

Swift Judgement.desc: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

Swiftmend.desc: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect.

Tactical Mastery.desc: You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.

Talented.desc: You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

Tame Beast.desc: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

Taunt.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

Teleport: Moonglade.desc: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

Templar's Bulwark.desc: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Tendon Rip.desc: Tears at an enemy's legs for 12 damage over 9 sec and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

The Quick and the Dead.desc: Increases movement speed while dead by 10% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 2 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.

druid.desc: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 2.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

hunter.desc: Increases the Armor of your pets by 30%.

Thick Hide.desc: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 2.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

Thorns.desc: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 3 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 600 sec.

Thunder Clap.desc: Blasts nearby enemies, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 10 sec and doing 10 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

Thundering Strikes.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

Thunderstomp.desc: Shakes the ground with thundering force, doing 53 to 61 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

Tidal Focus.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

Tidal Mastery.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.

Torment.desc: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker.

Totemic Call.desc: Relocates your active totems to your location.

Totemic Focus.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 25%.

Totemic Mastery.desc: The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

Totemic Recall.desc: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

Touch of Weakness.desc: The next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 43 for 120 sec.

mage.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

paladin.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

priest.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

rogue.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

warlock.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

warrior.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

Touch of the Grave.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

paladin.desc: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.

warrior.desc: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

Toughness.desc: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

Track Beasts.desc: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Tranquility.desc: Regenerates all nearby party members within 20 yards for 91 every 2 sec for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

Tranquilizing Shot.desc: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

Transmute: Arcanite.desc: Transmutes a bar of Thorium and an Arcane Crystal into an Arcanite Bar.

Transmute: Legionite.desc: Transmutes a bar of Heavy Thorium and a Fel Crystal into a Legionite Bar.

Travel Form.desc: Shapeshift into Travel Form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Trial by Fire.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 4 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 20 sec.

Trickster's Dance.desc: Increases your pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases the time between your pet's attacks by 30% for 12 sec.

Trueshot Aura.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

Turn Evil.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Turn Undead spell by 1.0 sec, its cooldown by 10 sec, and allows it to affect Demons.

Turn Undead.desc: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

Twilight Focus.desc: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Twin Disciplines.desc: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

Two-Handed Axes and Maces.desc: Allows you to use Two-Handed Axes and Two-Handed Maces.

paladin.desc: Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

warrior.desc: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.desc: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

Unbreakable Will.desc: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 30%.

Unbridled Wrath.desc: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

Unholy Power.desc: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

Unleashed Fury.desc: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.

Unsealed Wrath.desc: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.

Unyielding Faith.desc: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

Vampiric Embrace.desc: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

Vanguard.desc: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

Vanish.desc: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

druid.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%.

paladin.desc: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

warlock.desc: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you a 30% increase to your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost. Additionally, while in Metamorphosis, Vengeance causes your wings to slow your falling speed.

Vengeance.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%.

Venom.desc: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

Victory Rush.desc: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + 15% of attack power) damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

Vile Poisons.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

Vindication.desc: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 204 for 30 sec.

Viper Sting.desc: Stings the target, draining 616 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Voice of Truth.desc: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

Voidwalker.desc: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

Volley.desc: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Walk on Air.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

mage.desc: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

priest.desc: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

Wand Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

War Stomp.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

Water Shield.desc: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

Weapon Expertise.desc: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

Weapon Mastery.desc: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 2%.

Weaponmaster.desc: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

Weaponsmith.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

Web.desc: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 12 Nature damage over 4 sec.

Well Rested.desc: Your rested experience accumulates 20% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 20%.

Whirlwind.desc: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

Wild Growth.desc: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 44 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

Will of the Forsaken.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

Wind Blessed.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.

Windfury Totem.desc: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 95 extra melee attack power. Lasts 300 sec.

Windfury Weapon.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 104 extra melee attack power. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Wing Clip.desc: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Winter's Chill.desc: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

Wisp Spirit.desc: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

Working Overtime.desc: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 10%.

Wound Poison.desc: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing all healing effects used on them by 67 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 90 charges.

Wrack.desc: Tears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster.

Wrath.desc: Causes 15 to 17 Nature damage to the target.
